title.narrative: AsDB Trust Fund for Renewable Energy

description.narrative: Due to that AsDB only have published Annual Partnering Reports from 2009 onwards, please find the report for the engagements covering years of 2009 - 2012 below. 2009: https://www.adb.org/documents/partnering-development-2009-donor-report 2010: https://www.adb.org/documents/partnering-development-2010-donor-report 2011: https://www.adb.org/documents/partnering-development-donor-report-2011 2012: https://www.adb.org/documents/partnering-development-donor-report-2012

The programme: Shall focus on renewable energy in rural areas and small towns. Will focus on conversion to increased efficiency and cleaner fuels in the energy supply systems and increased efficiency and conservation at the end use level. Shall provided resources to review national policies and develop a policy agenda as well as strengthen the institutional capacity and technical capability of local organsiations to promote, as well as analyse, renewable energy and energy efficiency. May also lend support to efforts to build up the institutional and manpower capacity for promoting green house gas abatement.
